concrete_capability_transition: no official human-facing CLI executable -> independent brownie-cli crate with brownie binary parser/help/version behavior and a thin runtime-client boundary

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Creates the official human-facing command surface for later headless objective execution while keeping runtime execution and continuation authority in Rust.
Establishes the CLI command architecture that later presents runtime-owned progress and next_action without exposing raw RPC choreography.
Keeps permission, workspace mutation, replay, recovery, and Mode Pack policy out of the CLI by limiting this slice to parsing and a thin runtime-client boundary.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with progress_visualization and runtime_permission_enforcement support by adding the official thin CLI executable architecture.
answers.new_capability: The workspace gains a brownie binary in an independent brownie-cli crate with help/version/basic parser behavior and a runtime-client boundary for later JSON-RPC host invocation.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Existing brownie-runtime is a stdin/stdout JSON-RPC host and direct terminal use only exposes runtime JSON, not a human workflow CLI.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: CLI Product DoD CLI-1 remains open and later status, run, resume, progress, output, packaging, and golden journey phases have no bounded command architecture to build on.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from Core Runtime completion and existing VSIX/runtime binaries because it adds the missing official terminal frontend without reopening runtime product completion.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. CLI-1 adds no runtime JSON-RPC method and does not mirror the RPC surface as CLI UX.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. CLI-1 adds no report, readiness, diagnostic wrapper, history, digest, verdict, inspection, summary, or documentation-only completion claim.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Runtime behavior is intentionally unchanged; user-facing behavior changes by adding an executable CLI parser and binary while preserving Rust runtime authority.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Humans can discover and invoke the general brownie run objective command shape needed for later headless autonomous execution through the existing runtime.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes CLI Product DoD gap CLI-1 only and leaves CLI-2 through CLI-10 open for bounded follow-up phases.

develop is not introduced as a primary command
runtime-client boundary does not implement runtime policy

accepted_capability: Brownie now has an official brownie CLI executable crate and binary skeleton.
The primary command shape is the general-purpose brownie run <objective>, not a development-only command.
behavior_evidence: Rust unit tests validate parser behavior, JSON error shaping, and the thin runtime-client boundary.
Integration tests execute the brownie binary for help, version, invalid invocation, and develop rejection.
cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo test --workspace, diagnostics guard, phase-value guard, product-completion guard, and VSIX checks remain required validation.
safety_boundary: CLI-1 does not add or change runtime JSON-RPC methods.
CLI-1 does not duplicate permission, replay, recovery, Mode Pack, Product DoD, product-completion, workspace mutation, or agent-loop policy in the CLI.
CLI-1 does not expose raw prompts, provider responses, file contents, stdout/stderr payloads, commands, environment, or secrets.
non_goals: No actual runtime transport connection yet.
No workspace mutation, provider/tool/verification execution, TUI, REPL, daemon discovery, or packaging release.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected brownie develop as the primary command because the CLI campaign requires a general brownie run <objective> surface.
Rejected arbitrary JSON-RPC passthrough because the CLI must be a human workflow surface, not an RPC mirror.
Rejected CLI-owned workflow, permission, replay, recovery, Mode Pack, Product DoD, and workspace mutation policy because Rust runtime authority remains the architecture invariant.
technical_debt: CLI runtime transport connection remains a required follow-up Product DoD gap.
CLI status, inspect, resume, mode-list, packaging, output contract, and golden journey behavior remain open CLI Product DoD gaps.
next_capability_rationale: After CLI-1 lands, the next bounded CLI Product DoD phase should connect brownie run to the existing Rust runtime host without adding CLI-owned policy.
Product completion is denied until all required CLI Product DoD gaps, blocking debt, and required_before_release debt are closed.
